name: openjetlag-mcp
description: OpenJetLag: a jet lag coach for personal AI agents, as a remote MCP server.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openjetlag/core && npm run build -w @openjetlag/mcp-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @openjetlag/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @openjetlag/core && npm run dev -w @openjetlag/mcp-server
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @openjetlag/core && npm run deploy -w @openjetlag/mcp-server
